integration_rules: Treat routes as static candidates, not executed vehicle trajectories.
Keep unknown visibility as null; never convert it to clear or zero risk.
Planning rejection does not prove a permanent map change or lane closure.
Use map/observation evidence, not planner detours, to decide map updates.
M3 review is available only at scene end in this replay; other frames do not consume its final results.
Preserve GT annotation fallback provenance and all rejected / unevaluable records.
All GeoJSON coordinates are metric city XY, not WGS84.
